title: Student Timetable
prompt: Create a timetable with a caption, row and column headings, and two data rows.
objective: Build a two-column timetable with two weekday rows.
expected_output: A valid, inspectable HTML example demonstrating: tables, headers, captions.
hints: Start with a table caption, then header cells and data cells. Use scope to clarify the headers.
Review the connected lesson and make one focused revision at a time.
Run a validator or manually inspect the relevant browser behavior.

solution.explanation: Reference approach: Start with a table caption, then header cells and data cells. Use scope to clarify the headers. Required structural evidence: <table>, <caption>, <th, <td>.

grading_method: server-side required-string smoke check plus human review for quality
retry_policy: Allow retries; only the first successful completion for this activity may award base XP. Incorrect submissions do not award XP.
status_note: Reference solution and grading configuration remain in backend content files; public exercise endpoints must omit them.
